checks: The imperative ‘please confirm that’ uniquely takes the bare verb. The other options are inflected forms or a noun. Both passages preserve the workstation, revision C and Tuesday build; all choices and rationales checked.

activeQuestion.prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [131].
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格 [131] 的字詞或句子。

options.whyZh: 祈使句 please 後使用原形 confirm。
後接 that 子句，confirm that 表示確認工作站有正確版本。
confirming 不能獨立構成此祈使句。
please 後此處需要動詞原形，不能用名詞。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 後接 that 子句，confirm that 表示確認工作站有正確版本。
activeQuestion.evidence: please confirm that your workstation has revision C

group.title: Pilot-build instructions
group.passage:
